name: Rt5.MaleAndroidControl
description: ASFR-oriented, in-person control suite for android objectification cosplay — a play prop, not a real machine. Master console app (Android + Windows desktop), Slave robot-side phone app and a Wear OS watch app, linked over a custom BLE GATT protocol. English UI, bilingual manual. Fictional product (Rt5 A.I.).

paragraphs: ASFR-oriented, in-person control suite — an objectification-cosplay prop rather than a real machine. One shared web front end plus a console app, a robot-side phone app, a Wear OS watch app and a Windows desktop build, linked over a custom BLE GATT protocol on a local link (no cloud dependency except the optional speech engine).

A fictional product, ASFR-oriented: a private, in-person control link for android objectification/materialisation cosplay — a prop for play, not a real machine. The setting and copy contain adult-oriented content; published for technical reference only.

Meeting your android in person is nothing like chatting online. Whispering an instruction across the table works, but it fades the moment it is spoken; typing it into a chat app flattens the scene entirely. What is missing is ritual.

requirements.text: Speech synthesis and recognition need a service provider API key entered in the app settings; no key ships with the repository.
